hushgram.title: v0.0.13
hushgram.body:
## [0.0.13](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.12...v0.0.13) (2026-10-18)

### Features

* **Instagram - Hide Follow on feed posts:** New patch. Feed posts show a Follow or Subscribe button next to the author's name, and this takes it off. The name, time and menu stay. The switch is under Feed and starts off. Asked for in #248.
* **Instagram - Hide the comment emoji row:** New patch. The comment box has a row of quick emoji above it, and this takes it off. The box stays. The switch is under Comments and starts off. Asked for in #248.
* **Instagram - Hide Follow on stories:** New patch. Stories from accounts you don't follow show a Follow button at the top again, and this takes it off. The name, time and menu stay. The switch is under Stories and starts off. Asked for in #237.

### Bug Fixes

* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** Importing a settings file, or undoing one, shows Restart now when a choice needs a restart, and the message asks for one only while it's owed. Before, nothing offered the restart.
* **Instagram - Download any reel:** Download cover saved a small copy, 360 pixels wide, since Instagram stopped sending larger ones. When the cover is the reel's first frame, it's taken from the video now, at the video's full size. Reported in #214.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested people on profiles:** A profile's buttons keep their spacing when Instagram redraws the row during a refresh. With the switch off or HushGram paused, Instagram's own button sizes stay. Reported in #220.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** Flipping Pause HushGram, or turning HushGram back on from the card at the top, shows Restart now right away. It used to show nothing to tap. Restart now also stopped hanging on "Instagram isn't responding" when HushGram was paused. Reported in #146.
* **Instagram - HushGram settings:** The Brazilian Portuguese settings read more naturally, reworded by votsz. From #230.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** With Burn-in guard faded, a tap that paused or played a reel lit the buttons up for up to a second before they dimmed again. They stay dim through the tap now. Reported in #162.
* **Instagram - Show if a profile follows you:** With the small label under the picture, the name and counts beside it slid down on some profiles. They stay where Instagram puts them now. Reported in #157.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** With the glass bar on, opening a reel's comments, Share or More could leave the video stuck on its cover, or frozen while the sound played on. The reel underneath is left alone when a sheet opens now. Reported in #222 and #232.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** Keep clear mode on missed some reels and left their buttons up when the next reel's controls showed up late. It waits for them now. Reported in #233.
* **Instagram - Find the reel you came from:** The search goes much further down a profile's reels before giving up, so an older reel many pages down is still found. It also waits out a slow page while Instagram's spinner shows. Reported in #225.
* **Instagram - Find the reel you came from:** A photo reel now works too. Instagram keeps those in a profile's posts instead of the Reels tab, so the search looks there for them. With Profile posts as a list on, the grid stays up for it. Reported in #225.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** With `Hide videos` or another Home switch on, a page with a post or two, or none at all, left Home on an endless spinner or the Welcome card. Home asks for the next page by itself now. Reported in #28.
* **Instagram - Hide suggested posts:** On Instagram 451 the "You've seen the latest posts" card draws the Suggested for you title itself, so it stayed with nothing under it. It goes away there too now, and Older posts stays. Reported in #104.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** With Hide the tab bar on Reels, a reel given the room back once the pill slid away ran under the gesture bar or the navigation buttons, where its seek bar couldn't be dragged. It stops just above them now. Reported in #221.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** On Android 17 the pill could stay over an open story and cover its reply box and reactions. It now steps aside whenever a story is open and comes back when you leave. Reported in #224.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** With Hide the tab bar on Reels, dragging a reel's seek bar while the pill is away moves through the reel instead of only bringing the pill back. A tap there still brings it back. Reported in #221.

### Improvements

* **Instagram - Story ring size:** Ring size goes from 50% to 150% now, in steps of ten, and the list shows each size as a percent. A size you picked before stays the same. Asked for in #223.
* **Instagram - Tap a feed video to pause it:** The switch's description now says that tapping the paused video again plays it, which it already did. Asked for in #137.
* **Instagram - Read messages without the seen receipt:** With Keep chats unread here off, a chat you open now stays read on this phone until a newer message comes in. Before, it went back to unread once your messages refreshed. The sender still sees no Seen. Asked for in #186.
* **Instagram - Blur the bars around Reels:** The strip under the tab bar on Reels now shows the reel blurred instead of black, under the floating glass pill and on Instagram's own tab bar. Home and the other tabs keep their usual bar. Asked for in #197.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** New `Tab bar corners` choice, right under Tab bar height. Rounder or Fully round gives the pill and its highlight rounder ends. Starts on Standard. The Liquid look is always round, so the choice rests while it's on. Asked for in #144.
* **Instagram - Glass tab bar:** `Slide across the tabs` works on Instagram's own tab bar now, with the glass off. Slide a finger along the tabs and a light box follows it. Let go and that tab opens. Asked for in #201.
* **Instagram - Full screen Reels and Home:** New `Bars to hide` choice, right under Full screen Reels. Full screen can hide both bars as before, or only the status bar at the top, or only the navigation bar at the bottom. Asked for in #231.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** New `Convert to keep the full size` switch, under Save videos other apps can open. A full size reel or story Instagram only has as VP9 or AV1 is converted to H.264 on your phone instead of saved smaller. Reported in #236.
* **Instagram - Download any video:** New `Choose carousel pages` switch. A carousel's menu and the download icon get Choose pages, right after Save all. Tick the pages you want and only those save, in order. Pages are numbered, with a small picture once it loads.
* **Instagram - Tap to play:** New `Wait after auto scroll` switch, under Where videos wait. With Instagram's auto scroll on, the reel it moves to waits for your tap too. Off, it plays reel after reel as before. Asked for in #175.
* **Instagram - Clean up Reels:** Two new switches under Reels, both off by default. One hides the Create (+) button at the top of every reel, the other hides Your algorithm on the Reels tab, and the bar closes up around them. Asked for in #177 and #217.
* **Instagram:** The diagnostic report now lists every card type the stories viewer checks, ads included, and how often Instagram asked to show the Music for you card. From #111 and #154.
* **Instagram:** What HushGram writes to Android's system log and its error toasts now leaves out tokens, signed links and files from your storage, the same way the exported report does. Error traces are checked too.
* **Instagram:** The diagnostic report listed Long press to zoom, Read messages without the seen receipt, Start Home on Following and Glass tab bar as off when only the switches under them were off. They show as on now.
* **Tooling:** An everyday push now builds once and runs only the tests its changes can reach, plus the checks that read every source. A change no test reaches stops the push. A release, or `HUSHGRAM_FULL_GATE=1`, still gets the full gate.
* **Tooling:** The release preflight now builds the bundle and runs every patch on the declared Instagram build, so a patch that stopped applying shows up in a few minutes rather than an hour into the release.
* **Tooling:** A push that changes where a patch hooks Instagram, but not `scripts/injected-mutation-contracts.txt`, now prints a one-line hint naming the patch. It never stops the push, and it shows on a skipped push too.
* **Tooling:** The release receipt now audits the Morphe Desktop JAR it patches with, tied to that file's SHA-256. Desktop's own Bouncy Castle and Guava are checked, and an advisory whose classes minimization removed isn't counted as exposure.
* **Tooling:** A Desktop advisory can only be accepted by a review that names the JAR's SHA-256, so a new Desktop gets read again. All five Bouncy Castle advisories the gate holds against Desktop 1.18.1 are reviewed as unreachable.

### Validation

Validation: 5676 runtime tests passed locally. All 2037 patch tests passed too.

hushpinterest.title: v0.0.12
hushpinterest.body:
HushPinterest 0.0.12 has 32 patches for Pinterest 14.41.0. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. This one moves to Pinterest's newest version and adds a lot of new switches, every one of them off until you turn it on. Filter feed can hide video pins and pins with words you mute. Keep Home feed stops Home from reloading on its own when you come back to it, and Show posted date puts the day a pin went up under its title. Download pins can copy or share the picture itself now, and its rows show in the full-screen pin menu too. Downloads also stopped settling for the smaller copy now and then.

It's a new Pinterest version. So far APKMirror only has 14.41.0 as an arm64 bundle (`.apkm`) for Android 12L or newer, and Manager merges it before patching. Patch it with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest, and your settings stay as they are. On a phone older than Android 12L, keep 0.0.11 and Pinterest 14.40.0 for now.

## What's new

- The patches now target Pinterest 14.41.0, the newest stable release. 14.40.0 is no longer supported. So far APKMirror has 14.41.0 only as an arm64 bundle (`.apkm`) for Android 12L or newer, and Manager merges it before patching.
- Download pin now shows in the full-screen pin menu some accounts get from the three dots on a pin, along with the other Hush rows, and Pinterest's own Download row in that menu gives way to it. Before, only the smaller pop-up menu had them.
- Download pins has a new switch, Copy image, that starts off. It adds a Copy image row under Download pin, in the small pin menu and in the full-screen one, and puts the full-size picture on the clipboard so you can paste it into a chat or a notes app. Video pins don't get the row. If the picture is too big, isn't really an image, or takes too long, you're told so and your clipboard stays as it was. (#11)
- Download pins also has Share image, another switch that starts off. Its row sits under Copy image and opens Android's share menu with the full-size picture itself rather than a link, so the app you pick gets the image. Video pins don't get it, and if the picture can't be fetched you get a short note instead of the share menu. (#11)
- Long-press download has three new switches on the Pin actions page: Hide Save, Hide Send and Hide Search image in the long-press menu. Each takes that one Pinterest button out of the round menu you get by holding a pin in a grid, and the pin itself still saves, shares and searches as before. They work with Download off too. If everything would be hidden and Download is off, the menu stays Pinterest's own rather than opening empty. All three start off. (#11)
- Black comments now covers the strip under the status bar too. On 14.41.0 the comments fill the whole screen, and that strip stayed dark gray above the black list on photo and video pins alike.
- Downloads no longer save the smaller copy now and then when the original is there. Finding the original asks Pinterest's media server a few quick questions, and one asked just as both lookup helpers were wrapping up the last was turned away, so the download settled for the size the feed showed. It now waits a moment for a helper to come free.
- Copy media link no longer overwrites something you copied after it. When a pin shows only a smaller size, the link to that size goes on the clipboard right away, and it becomes the original's link once Pinterest's media server answers, but only if the clipboard still holds that copy. Before, nothing was copied until the answer came, and a slow answer could replace whatever you'd copied in the meantime.
- Save list no longer hangs when the app holding the picked file stops answering. Each save gets 30 seconds in all, then you're told to check the file, and a late answer from that app doesn't add another message or remove anything. While that app is still busy, a new list says to try later instead of opening a picker. Everything that talks to the file's app now runs on its own helper, never on the screen's thread, including the clean-up after a list that couldn't be written while HushPinterest was paused.
- A list that isn't written no longer deletes an empty file you picked to write over. Only an empty file made since the picker opened gets removed. Any other file is left where it is, and you're told so.
- Save list leaves out a source link that hides a session code behind an encoded `;` (`%3B`, that encoded again, or a longer spelling some servers still read as `;`), the way it already left out a plain `;jsessionid=`. The pin's ID, title and Pinterest link still go in. Ordinary encoded spaces and accented letters stay exactly as given.
- Queue selected and Queue pins stay off until something chosen can actually be saved. A pin with no picture address, or a video Pinterest only streams, doesn't turn them on anymore, though Save list still takes those pins. A mix still queues what it can and counts the rest as unsupported.
- Morphe Manager lists every change of the release your Pinterest was patched with, not just a short summary. For that one release Manager shows the patch bundle's description instead of this changelog, and the description was one paragraph while every older release listed its changes. It now goes on with the release's changes after the summary, starting with this one.
- Hide comments has a second switch, Hide suggested replies, for the row of ready-made replies like "Yum!" and "Came out great!" next to the comment box. You can still write your own comment. It starts off, and the two switches don't turn each other on. (#14)
- Hide AI-labeled pins has a second switch, Hide pins that say they're AI, for AI pins Pinterest doesn't label. It takes a pin whose title or description says something like "AI art", "AI generated", #aiart, "made with AI", Midjourney, Stable Diffusion or PixAI, and pins from sites that only host AI images, like pixai.art and Civitai. It goes by the pin's own words, so a pin that just says "AI" stays, and names like Ai Weiwei or the Portuguese "aí" are left alone. Boards named that way stay too. It starts off, and diagnostics count these pins apart from the labeled ones.
- Hide closeup buttons has a third switch, Hide Search image label on pins. Pinterest puts a "Search image" label on the lens button for your first two pins each day, and with this on the lens shows without it, the way it looks from the third pin on. Tapping the lens still searches. It starts off and sits under Hide lens button on the Interface page. (#13)
- New Filter feed patch, with a Hide video pins switch on the Feed page. It takes pins that play a video out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards, idea pins with video included. Photos and GIFs stay. It starts off.
- Filter feed also has Muted words, a row on the Feed page where you type words and phrases you don't want to see. A pin whose title or description has one of them leaves the same lists. Capitals don't matter and only whole words count, so "cake" takes out "Wedding Cake Ideas" but not cupcakes. The list holds 50 entries of up to 40 characters, starts empty, and goes into settings files with your switches. Boards named after a muted word stay.
- New Keep Home feed patch, with its switch on the Feed page. Pinterest reloads Home with new pins on its own when you come back after five minutes or more, when you pick the Home tab again after a while and when you back out of a search, and the pin you were about to open is gone. With this on, Home stays where you left it. Pull down whenever you want new pins. The new pins prompt, a second tap on the Home tab and a pin you open from a notification still load as before. It starts off.
- New Show posted date patch, with its switch on the Interface page. Pinterest sends the day each pin was posted but never shows it, and with this on you see "Posted" and that day under the title when you open a pin. A pin without a date just doesn't get the line. The date follows the language HushPinterest shows and your phone's time zone. It starts off and shows from the next pin you open. (#11)
- With Debug logging on, the line for a kept pin also says whether Pinterest marked it as a repin or as saved to one of your boards. It shows only that the field is set, never which board.
- The Feed page has a new row under the AI switches, Pinterest's own AI setting. It opens the page where Pinterest lets you see fewer AI pins among the ones it picks for you, since neither that page nor the switches catch every AI pin alone. It's there whenever Hide AI-labeled pins is patched in.

## Behind the scenes

- The pin model fixture test also checks the fields Hide video pins reads, the two inside Pinterest's video and idea pin models included, and the grid title that the AI words and video filters use to tell a pin from other models.
- The pre-push and release checks take a declared build kept as APKMirror's `.apkm` bundle, since that's the only way 14.41.0 ships. The bug report form's example names a bundle too, and the release step keeps whatever kind of file the form names.
- The release gate's advisory check works in Windows PowerShell 5.1 again. Since 0.0.11, any failed OSV request stopped it there with an "Unable to find type" error. A dropped connection or a busy server now gets asked again in 5.1, the way it already did in PowerShell 7.
- The README's Help now goes through why Android might refuse the install. It says where Manager keeps its signing key, so an update that won't go over your patched copy can be fixed without losing your settings. It also covers stock Pinterest and the unknown apps prompt.
- The README sends people on v0.0.11 to Pinterest 14.40.0 again, the build that release patches, and names 14.41.0 as the next release's build. It had pointed them at 14.41.0, which v0.0.11 refuses. The release's prepare step now stops while the README still names a next release, so it gets rewritten for the new build before a release is cut.
- The patch verifier checks how the long-press hide switches tell Pinterest's buttons apart. The sorter has to read the held button's own id and send Save, Send and both search ids to the right answer, with the ids found the way the patch finds them, and a build without them has to keep the plain answer.
- The bug report form lists Filter feed among the patches you can tick. It was the one patch the form left out, and the release check stopped on that.
- The release check and the publish step leave a GitHub description alone when it names no version, patch count or Pinterest build, since there's nothing in it to go stale. One that names any of them still has to match the release. This release would have stopped on the shorter description the repository uses now.
- The source census reads Jman's bundle registry again. On October 14 the registry took down the files the audit read and now serves the same list from its own site, so every audit since stopped on a missing file. It reads all of the site's pages, not only the first hundred releases.
- The device scripts write their lease times in UTC with a `Z` at the end. They used `+00:00`, and the other tools sharing the test phone took a lease written that way as already expired. They also read a `Z` time as UTC now. Before, a busy phone's expiry was read as local clock time, so an expired lease looked hours from ending.
- The script tests now clean up after themselves. The pre-push cases remove the worktree the hook builds in, and a passing host reference run deletes its report folder. Each run used to leave both in the temp directory.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest

hushtelegram.title: v0.0.19
hushtelegram.body:
HushTelegram v0.0.19 has 67 patches for Telegram 13.0.3, and it patches two builds now. One is telegram.org's (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 71839). The other is the build from Google Play (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 71831), the one most people already have on their phone. Sixty-three are selected by default, and every new switch starts off. The last release only knew telegram.org's build, so Morphe Manager turned the Play APK away with "Wrong package selected." Now either one patches, and telegram.org's build works exactly as it did. The official beta isn't a target anymore. If you're on it, move to telegram.org's build or the Play one before you patch. The first time you sign in, Telegram may turn down the API ID that ships with any patched build and show `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, so no login code arrives. It's the same on every patched Telegram, HushTelegram included. The one-time fix is to register your own Telegram API credentials, and the steps are under Install.

## What's new

* **Telegram:** The Google Play version of Telegram 13.0.3 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 71831) can be patched now. That's the APK APKMirror and Uptodown carry, and Morphe Manager used to turn it away with "Wrong package selected" because it only knew telegram.org's build. telegram.org's build still works the same way.
* **Telegram:** **Repair Firebase push registration** also covers the Play build, so its notifications sign up with Google like they do on telegram.org's build.
* **Telegram:** The official Telegram beta isn't a target anymore. **Turn off beta debug logs** is gone with it, and so is the part of **Disable analytics** that only stopped the beta's crash and session reports. If you're on the beta, switch to telegram.org's build or the Play build before you patch.

### Tooling

* **Tooling:** The release's clean-APK check accepts the Google Play build as a vendor baseline. It now asks that the signing certificate the catalog declares for the package be present on the APK, and it allows the extra certificate Google Play App Signing adds. Before, it required every certificate on the APK to be one the catalog declared, so the Play build's Google certificate stopped the release even though the patcher applied every patch to it.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get Telegram 13.0.3. Two builds work: telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 71839) and the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 71831), the one most people already have, which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from an earlier HushTelegram on telegram.org's build? Patch the new 13.0.3 APK and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. On the beta? It isn't a target now, so switch to telegram.org's build or the Play build, patch that, and install it fresh, since it's a different app than the beta and Android won't put one over the other. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, for the same reason. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. Phones where Firebase notifications don't come through can also try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The side menu is the `Side menu` switch on the Chat list page.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

## Validation

All 1348 runtime tests passed locally, and all 481 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 67 patches applied to Telegram 13.0.3 without forcing, on both telegram.org's build (version code 71839) and the Google Play build (version code 71831). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, native libraries and zip alignment. The Google Play build was also installed on a clean Android 13 system and launched straight to Telegram's sign-in screen with no crash.

hushthreads.body:
HushThreads v0.0.15 has 19 patches for Threads 451.0.0.51.80 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it patches that version only. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so you need Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer.

2. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 451.0.0.51.80 (version code 512108444), the same Threads build as v0.0.14.
3. Manager's default selection has every patch except `Change version code`, `Remove share targets` and `Trust user-added certificates`. Turn on Expert mode if you want any of those.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data and your login. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
5. On a fresh install, sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

994 runtime tests and 281 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 19 patches applied without forcing to Threads 451.0.0.51.80, and the release receipt records the run. The dependency advisory check passed.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.15 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 451.0.0.51.80 (version code 512108444), the same Threads build as v0.0.14.
3. Manager's default selection has every patch except `Change version code`, `Remove share targets` and `Trust user-added certificates`. Turn on Expert mode if you want any of those.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data and your login. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
5. On a fresh install, sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).
